followUps.description: The adapter's tool-message resolve path now accepts both wire shapes: a full continuation id (frontend waits) or a bare remote id, which it addresses to the thread's current run's remote continuation (`<runId>.wait.remote:<remoteId>`); unknown ids still fail closed through the service's continuation lookup. Wire projection is unchanged (archived shapes stay valid). Regression tests: packages/ag-ui/test/remote-offer.test.ts (generic client completes the round trip, TOOL_CALL_RESULT projected, run completes) and the copilot protocol suite's 'a generic AG-UI client completes the remote-offer round trip via the standard tool-message path' test, which failed with RUN_ERROR not_found before the fix.

followUps.title: RESOLVED 2026-10-01: run-level CUSTOM payloads are self-sufficient; resolution rides the standard forwardedProps field
followUps.description: AG-UI 1.0.0 has no interrupt event, so run-level waits surface as CUSTOM (cognate.continuation / cognate.unsupported_interaction) — projecting a tool call for them would contradict the reference's own characterization (RUN_FINISHED plus interrupt payload, not a tool result). The payload now carries everything a generic client needs to act through the STANDARD RunAgentInput.forwardedProps field (forwardedProps.cognate.resolve/cancel): continuation id, type, kind, payload, runId, threadId — no rawEvent parsing required. Asserted by packages/ag-ui/test/remote-offer.test.ts and the copilot protocol suite's runtime-interrupt test.
